title: Term of a Formulary Exception Approval: Effective Date, Expiration, Strengths and Renewal
content:
## Clauses

**1. Retired term clauses.** The clause under which *a standard approval is effective on the decision date and runs for the formulary's standard approval length in calendar months* is **no longer in force**. The clause under which *an expedited approval runs the formulary's expedited approval length in calendar days, with the decision date as day 1,* is also **no longer in force**. The length of each kind of approval now follows the current approval-length basis of the Formulary Benefit. The formulary's approval-length figures themselves remain part of the formulary's terms.

**2. Expiration date of a month-based approval (in force).** An approval that runs a number of calendar months expires on the day before the same day-of-month that many months later. When that day-of-month does not exist in the closing month, the last day of that month is used, and the expiration date is the day before it.

**3. Strengths.** An approval covers only the drug and strength requested. Where the member's Northbridge formulary carries approvals over to other strengths, it also covers other strengths of the same drug.

**4. Renewal.** A renewal is a new request. It may be opened from the formulary's renewal lead (a number of calendar days) before the current approval's expiration date. When approved, its effective date is the day after the current expiration date.

**5. Out-of-pocket.** Cost share paid under an approved exception counts toward the out-of-pocket maximum where the formulary so provides.

**6. Reassignment.** Approved exceptions survive a formulary reassignment only through the end of the plan year in which the reassignment happens.

## Worked dates (hypothetical)

| Effective date | Months | Closing day-of-month | Expiration date |
|---|---|---|---|
| 15 March 2026 | 12 | 15 March 2027 | 14 March 2027 |
| 31 August 2026 | 6 | 31 February does not exist, so 28 February 2027 is used | 27 February 2027 |
| 10 January 2026 | 1 | 10 February 2026 | 9 February 2026 |

*Renewal example.* The current approval expires on 14 March 2027, and the formulary's renewal lead is 45 days. A renewal request may be opened from 28 January 2027. If it is approved, it takes effect on 15 March 2027.

superseded_clauses: A standard approval is effective on the decision date and runs for exception_approval_months calendar months
an expedited approval runs expedited_exception_duration_days calendar days with the decision date as day 1
